def transform(grid):
    import numpy as np
    from scipy import ndimage
    a=np.array(grid)
    lab,_=ndimage.label(a>0)
    def bb(m):
        ys,xs=np.where(m); return m[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]
    b1,b2=[bb(lab==i) for i in (1,2)]
    H=max(b1.shape[0],b2.shape[0]); W=max(b1.shape[1],b2.shape[1])
    A=np.zeros((H,W),bool); B=A.copy()
    A[:b1.shape[0],:b1.shape[1]]=b1; B[:b2.shape[0],:b2.shape[1]]=b2
    x=A^B
    return [[8 if v else 0 for v in r] for r in x]
